අƯ ɪෙශෂ EXTRAORDINARY The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998

It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the owner-ship or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands reflected in the Cadastral Map No. 530091 made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 relating to the village of Deshasthra Kalutara (Block 01) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Nilad-hari Division of 717 D - Deshasthra West in the Divisional Secre-tariat Division of Kalutara in the District of Kalutara in the Prov-ince of Western should submit his claim to the undersigned before 28th September, 2017 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly pub-lish such determination in the Government Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act. The Cadastral Map No. 530091 referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretariat, District Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Set-tlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office. Further information may be obtained from the Grama Niladhari, the Divisional Secretary, or the Commissioner of Land Title Set-tlement. K.A.K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 13th August, 2017. 09 - 1056 / 1
